# Inkwell Writing Handbook

> Original reusable writing workflows and templates maintained by Inkwell.

- [Start here](https://github.com/inkwell-app/writing-handbook/blob/main/README.md): purpose, task paths and the resource directory.
- [Template selection](https://github.com/inkwell-app/writing-handbook/blob/main/docs/choose-a-template.md): choose the smallest useful artifact.
- [Screenplay example](https://github.com/inkwell-app/writing-handbook/blob/main/examples/the-last-light.md): original fictional revision exercise.
- [Structured-document example](https://github.com/inkwell-app/writing-handbook/blob/main/examples/library-workshop.md): synthetic decision and evidence exercise.
- [Inkwell](https://www.inkwell.software/): canonical product information.

Templates and examples are MIT licensed. External resources retain their own licenses. Product availability and pricing belong to the canonical website.
